name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new feature for Fulcrum Suite
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature or overlay

Which part of Fulcrum Suite is this suggestion related to?

Example:
- Fulcrum Relatives
- Fulcrum DigiFlags
- Fulcrum Radar
- Fulcrum Strategy Engineer
- New overlay

## Feature description

Describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Why would this be useful?

Explain what problem it would solve or how it would improve the experience.

## Suggested behavior

Describe how you imagine the feature working.

## Similar implementations

If another dashboard, overlay, race car display or application has something similar, you can include screenshots, videos or references here.

## Additional information

Anything else that could help explain the idea.
